description: Third-party corpora for budgets, spikes and differential tests (PLAN.md section 4, Corpora). They are test inputs only: never linked, never committed, never consulted as source (clean-room rule). tools/corpus_fetch.py shallow-fetches each pinned commit into E:\corpus\<id> on Windows or ~/corpus/<id> on Linux and verifies HEAD equals the pinned SHA. Pins were resolved with `git ls-remote` on 2026-10-31; 'tag_object' is the annotated tag's own object where the tag is annotated. 'approx_size_mb' is the repository size GitHub reported on 2026-10-31 (full history), a rough guide to the download; corpus_fetch.py prints the checked-out size. R1 (FrostIDE itself), R4 (synth-xl), R5, S50, F1 and F2 are generated or local and have no entry here.

corpora.name: Notepad++

corpora.prerequisites: Windows with VS 2022 Build Tools, Desktop development with C++ (v143) and a Windows 10/11 SDK; MSBuild solution.

corpora.name: llvm-project
corpora.release: LLVM 23.1.4, the pinned toolchain release (sdk/sdk.lock.json); the commit matches the one the pinned binaries report.
corpora.prerequisites: CMake and Ninja from the pinned SDK, Python 3, the pinned Clang. R3 configures with Ninja; R3s is the same checkout configured with the "Visual Studio 18 2026" generator (v145, needs VS 2026 Build Tools). Several GB of free space on E: (Windows) or ext4 (WSL).
corpora.purpose: Large CMake corpus for most budgets (B1-B26), the clangd index spike S7, File API and compile-database differentials; R3s exercises the VS generator.
